subject: Weekly forecast check-in + risk orchestration
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Lee <sarah.lee@acmecorp.com>, procurements@acmecorp.com
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-05-18T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Weekly forecast check-in + risk orchestration

Hi Sarah / ACME procurement team,

Quick reminder ahead of our check-in at 11:00 PT today — want to make sure we have a clean commit in the forecast and have surfaced any outstanding procurement/security items that could block sign. Agenda below (20 min):

1) Current commit status (SFDC) — who’s committed vs at-risk
2) Open items: SOC2 evidence, data-retention SLA, KMS integration
3) Pricing and billing milestones for Q3 start (any procurement thresholds?)
4) Next steps & signatures (DocuSign link will be queued)

Please update the deal stage in Salesforce before the call and add any risk tags you want us to track (e.g., legal-review, kyc, data-retention). I attached an updated forecast template that we’ll use to lock numbers.

Attachments: forecast_template_v3.xlsx (xlsx)

If you can’t make 11:00 PT, reply with a quick note and we’ll reschedule.

Thanks —
Jordan Blake
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0210

---
Redwood Inference — unified inference runtime for production LLMs

Date: 2028-05-18T09:43:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Weekly forecast check-in + risk orchestration

Jordan — thanks for the heads up. I’ll join at 11:00 PT. Two quick items for the call:

- Our finance team needs a cost run-rate estimate that shows month 1 and month 6 burn at the proposed configuration. Can you bring a short slide or numbers?
- We have a KMS requirement for EU workloads; can you confirm if that will be in scope for this logo (we’ll start with US, but will need the option soon).

I updated the contact list you can reach for procurement in the cc. See you at 11.

Cheers,
Sarah
Director of IT Procurement | ACME Corp
Sarah.Lee@acmecorp.com

Subject: Follow-up: ACME commit confirmed + artifacts attached

Thanks everyone for a productive check-in — quick summary and next steps so we have a single source of truth: 

- Commit: ACME confirmed intent to proceed; SFDC updated to Commit at $195k ARR (Marissa).
- Procurement: ACME to share final PO by 2028-05-25. Procurements@acmecorp.com to send DocuSign link when ready.
- Open gating items: legal is reviewing the data-retention addendum (tracked as risk tag: data-retention).
- KMS: We confirmed US rollout first; EU KMS support is on our roadmap and Vivek will provide a one-week feasibility note by 2028-05-25.
- Finance: Attached run-rate sheet and the signed commit summary PDF.

Attachments: ACME_commit_summary_20280518.pdf (pdf)

Next steps (owners):
- Marissa: follow up with ACME procurement on PO and DocuSign (due 2028-05-25).
- Vivek: feasibility note on EU KMS (due 2028-05-25).
- Rishi: schedule a 30-minute kickoff once PO is received.

If anything above is incorrect, flag here and I’ll update the HubSpot deal record.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
